biggest_catch: The full $100 takes six months of continuous service plus two separate mailed claim forms — miss a deadline and that $50 is gone.
catches: Requires an active account in good standing at time of processing.
Each $50 claim form must be submitted within 90 days of the eligibility date or the card is forfeited.
Limit one $100 card cycle per account.
The second $50 requires staying through the sixth month.

steps: Sign up for a qualifying Spark Energy electricity plan.
Print and complete the Prepaid Card request form.
For the first $50 card: attach a copy of your first monthly bill showing Spark Energy as your electric supplier; submit within 90 days of the end of your first month.
For the second $50 card: submit a second Prepaid Card request form with a copy of your sixth monthly bill showing Spark Energy as your supplier, within 90 days of the end of your sixth month.
Allow 4-6 weeks processing; the card is mailed to the account holder.
timing: Enrollment plus two mailed claim forms; cards arrive 4-6 weeks after each valid claim.
